q: What distinguishes pyramidal training from simply assigning a senior technician to train new hires?
choices: A. New hires receive the written materials first
B. The technician's training fidelity is measured
C. Training occurs during regular paid work hours
D. The senior technician has more field experience

q: The most significant assessment limitation introduced by observing a session over video is:
choices: A. The client's awareness of being recorded
B. Difficulty scoring the frequency of responses
C. Delays in transmitting the video signal
D. Antecedent events outside the camera frame

q: Which is the earliest reliable indicator that a supervisor has taken on too many supervisees?
choices: A. Clients on supervisee caseloads stop progressing
B. Direct observation is replaced by reviewing self-report
C. Documentation is submitted after the monthly deadline
D. Supervisees begin missing scheduled meeting times
